{{ID|00261d41}} }} '''Middle Mountain Lake'''Atlas of Appalachia – Savage Divide: Zone C: '''114. Middle Mountain Lake.''' ''"A lake with two deck chairs; the pair of fishing folk went skinny-dipping headfirst into the rocks farther along the lake shore."'' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== Located in the [[Savage Divide]] region on a plateau north of the [[Middle Mountain Cabins]], this is one of 36 places where the effect of memory blackout due to [[Nukashine]] can transfer. A picturesque shallow lake on a mountain plateau once became a resting place for two fishermen. At least one of them was a fisherman, and the other was a ranger, judging by the clothes they left behind: a fisherman's outfit and a ranger's outfit. Total bitelessness and drunk beer made them look for new adventures, which ended tragically for them. The skeletons of these would-be fishermen now serve as a reminder that alcohol and water are incompatible. With the return of the people to Appalachia, the tent on the opposite bank was staked out by the scavengers. You can always find a bottle of Nukashine in the tent itself. ==Appearances== Middle Mountain Lake appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (17).jpg|Sun loungers, near which there is an empty bottle of Nukashine FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (11).jpg|Lake FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (12).jpg|The place where the fishermen left their clothes FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (13).jpg|Fisherman skeletons FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (14).jpg|Tourist tent FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (15).jpg|Garbage man FO76 Middle Mountain Lake (16).jpg ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unmarked locations]] [[Category:The Mire locations]] [[ru:Озеро у Средней горы]]

BBMountainPOI33Ext |refid ={{ID|00263f1b}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |chems =yes |power armor =yes }} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMTR}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocEncSupportGiant}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocEncSupportLarge}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeRedRocket}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScalePOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} }} The '''Red Rocket filling station''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== A small gas station just off the state route, this [[Red Rocket]] was used as a staging area during the [[automation riots]], now slowly disappearing beneath the dust of the Ash Heap. ==Layout== The original filling station building is boarded up. There is a shed with a [[U-Mine-It! vending machine]] outside, while random loot and a [[My stash box|stash box]] can be found inside. Behind the boarded-up station, there is a [[Power armor station (Fallout 76)|power armor station]]. ==Notable loot== * [[Power armor chassis]] with T-series armor pieces - In a power armor station behind the boarded-up brick filling station and the orange fuel tanks on the north side. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - On the roof of the filling station, on the southeast corner. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - On the raised concrete portion of the metal maintenance garage, in the narrow gap between two green cabinets, near the stash box. ==Appearances== The Red Rocket filling station appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== PowerArmor Red Rocket FIlling Station.png|Power armor location F76 Red Rocket Filling Station.png|On a cloudy day FO76 Location 12621 37.png|In a [[blast zone]] {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Ash Heap locations]] [[Category:Red Rocket locations]] [[fr:Station-service Red Rocket]] [[ru:Заправочная станция «Красная ракета»]]

{{Infobox location |games =FO76 |type =factory |image =FO76 Summersville Dam.png |map marker ='''Summersville Dam''' |map marker image =Summersville Dam map.png |local map = |part of =[[Summersville]]
[[The Forest]], [[Appalachia]] |sections = |buildings = |doctors = |leaders = |merchants = |owners = |factions = |creatures =[[Scorched]] |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name =SummersvilleDamExt
SummersvilleDamExt02-04 |refid ={{ID|002638c1}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionForestFloodlands}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeGeneral}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} |edid =LocForestSummersvilleDamLocation }} The '''Summersville Dam''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[the Forest]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== The Summersville Dam is a pre-[[Great War|War]] construct that created the [[Summersville Lake]] and provided hydroelectric power to [[Charleston]]. The residents of the city were close to having the power plant repaired before the events of [[the Christmas Flood]] destroyed it.[[The power plant]]''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]'' p. 346, Summersville Dam: ''"At the eastern end of the Charleston ruins are the remains of the main dam. Those with a penchant for understatement could describe this structure as "compromised." This was recently a Raider camp, and these deceased thugs have left some traps for the unwary. Head up from the lake bed (check the green boat cabin for a trunk) via the ladders and wreckage on the north side of the dam ruins. There's a small pump house and a rope bridge across the gap where the dam was. Watch for those traps!"'' After [[Cutthroats|the Cutthroat]] [[Rosalynn Jeffries]] was captured by the [[Responders]], her partner, [[David Thorpe]], believing her to have perished, used a [[Mini nuke (Fallout 76)|mini nuke]] to avenge her by destroying the dam on Christmas morning. This caused Summersville Lake to catastrophically flood Charleston, killing Rosalynn and over one thousand other survivors and Responder members in what would be known as the Christmas Flood.[[The Christmas Flood (holotape)]] ==Layout== A group of [[Raiders (Fallout 76)|raiders]] built watchtowers and a crude bridge across the gap. The bridge has a broken middle section that must be jumped across. ==Notable loot== * [[Charleston is ours]] - Note, on a table on one of the guard towers below the dam, along the scaffolding leading to the bottom. * [[Cursed]] - Note, on the bridge connecting the two ends of the dam, next to a dead raider. * [[The Evil Men]] - Note, inside of the wreckage of a green boat at the bottom of the dam. * [[The power plant]] - Note, on a desk next to a broken terminal in the building at the top of the dam. ==Appearances== The Summersville Dam appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Behind the scenes== The Summersville Dam is a [[Wikipedia:Summersville Lake|real dam]] located in West Virginia. ==Gallery== FO76 Loc new 18.png|At dawn F76 Summersville Dam.png|Bridge FO76 Summersville Dam (Charleston is ours).png|[[Charleston is ours]] FO76 paper note Cursed (location).jpg|[[Cursed]] FO76 Summersville Dam (The Evil Men).png|[[The Evil Men]] FO76 Summersville Dam (The power plant).jpg|[[The power plant]] FO76 Summersville Dam concept art.png|Concept art ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[Category:Dams]] [[fr:Barrage de Summersville]] [[ru:Плотина Саммерсвилла]] [[uk:Гребля Саммерсвілла]] [[zh:薩默斯維爾水壩]]
